resources.string: Got it
Turn off tips
Smart corrections fixed a typo
“%1$s” became “%2$s” because the words around it made it clear. If you disagree, tap the undo button above the keyboard to change it back.
Smart corrections caught a missed typo
“%1$s” isn’t a word, so it worked out “%2$s” from the letters you typed and the sentence around them. If you disagree, tap the undo button above the keyboard to change it back.
It will be more careful here
Undoing a fix teaches Smart corrections to be more cautious about that change in this context in the future. To stop that fix everywhere, tap Stop while it shows.
Thanks, that teaches it
“%1$s” wasn’t fixed, so you changed it to “%2$s” yourself. That makes Smart corrections more ready to make this fix in this context in the future.
Teach it your typos
With one word selected, tap Add correction above the keyboard to tell Smart corrections what you meant. Next time you mistype it that way, it can fix it for you, like “pour” → “pout”.
Smart corrections tidied your dictation
It fixes things like misheard words, numbers, filler words and spoken commands. Choose what it changes, and how readily, under Settings → Voice input → Smart corrections.
Show feature tips
A short tip the first time you meet a feature, like your first typing fix or the Add correction button.
Show tips again
Tips you’ve seen will show again when you next meet their feature.
Tips will show again.
Swiping learns too

Pluto learns where your swipes start, end and turn over each key, and adjusts new swipes to match, so it gets better the more you swipe. You can change how strongly it adapts, or reset it, under Swipe Typing.
